ownership: All stock adjustments and original command receipts remain in the existing warehouse owner; canonical supplier event rows are an additive reconciliation projection

events.supplier_return: Observed base-unit quantity no larger than received minus returned; reduce available/on-hand and freeze the exact return credit obligation at the reviewed receipt cost
events.receipt_correction: Observed signed base-unit correction links to the original movement. Effective received cannot fall below returned or exceed ordered less source-observed cancellation. Keep original receipt rows unchanged
events.cost_correction: Independently reviewed new minor-unit purchase price changes a receipt cost projection and exposes variance. It never edits immutable approved PO prices or original receipt history
events.credit: Original source-observed credit is bounded by the linked supplier-return credit obligation, recorded once, and has no stock or payment effect

costs.purchase_conversion: exact quantity times purchase price divided by approved integer units-per-purchase
costs.later_cost_corrections: Do not rewrite already frozen credit obligations

identity: One native supplier event ID and original receipt ID, protected across new caller operation IDs and response loss
current_authority: The same receipt/proposer/reviewer/source/stops/recovery checks as purchase receiving are repeated at the original native transaction boundary; actual current supplier handle required for new effects
unknown: Lookup only at original warehouse identity; retain original uncertain operation and any committed source receipt
privacy_restore: Explicit allowlists, no invented customer linkage, preserve original receipt/cost lineage and unknown command identity; revoke all current stock review/effect authority on import/restore/uninstall
targeted_fault: Actual isolated recordSupplierReceiptEvent deletes the original purchase receipt; independent SQL count detects lost history
remaining_limits: No supplier payment, refund or settlement is executed or inferred
Returns do not silently reopen incoming purchase quantity
Source observations remain synthetic fixture administration
Separate native stores and historical copies require separate authorized cleanup
